title: dkim_e2e tests: test_e2e_no_dkim_signer_passthrough doesn't test production code
description: dkim_e2e.rs test_e2e_no_dkim_signer_passthrough and relay_queue.rs test_relay_dkim_signing_absent both simulate the None branch inline rather than calling production code. The if-else block in each test is a reimplementation of the branch, not an invocation of it. These tests assert that a local if-else written in the test behaves as expected -- not that the production drain_once or try_deliver_one code paths pass bytes through unchanged. Real coverage requires calling the production function.
